name: props_idealgas_range
source:
{ IdealGas (JANAF cubic fits) across the full temperature range and at the
  awkward edges. R_U is the TRUNCATED 8.31446 in the Java, not 8.314462618, so a
  "corrected" constant shows up in the 7th digit of every mass-basis output.
  volume/density deliberately do NOT call requirePositiveTemperature in the Java --
  probe that too. Every alias species is exercised once. }
h_n2_1     = Enthalpy(N2, T=1)
h_n2_100   = Enthalpy(N2, T=100)
h_n2_298   = Enthalpy(N2, T=298.15)
h_n2_1000  = Enthalpy(N2, T=1000)
h_n2_3000  = Enthalpy(N2, T=3000)
h_n2_20000 = Enthalpy(N2, T=20000)

cp_n2_1    = Cp(N2, T=1)
cp_n2_3000 = Cp(N2, T=3000)
cv_n2_3000 = Cv(N2, T=3000)
u_n2_3000  = IntEnergy(N2, T=3000)

s_n2_1     = Entropy(N2, T=1, P=101325)
s_n2_pref  = Entropy(N2, T=298.15, P=101325)
s_n2_lowp  = Entropy(N2, T=500, P=1)
s_n2_highp = Entropy(N2, T=500, P=1e9)
g_n2       = Gibbs(N2, T=1500, P=101325)

{ volume/density have no positive-T guard in the reference: negative T is a
  silently negative specific volume, and it must stay that way. }
v_neg      = Volume(N2, T=-5, P=101325)
rho_neg    = Density(N2, T=-5, P=101325)
v_tiny_p   = Volume(N2, T=300, P=1e-8)
z_any      = Compressibility(N2, T=-999, P=1e-30)
z_alias    = CompressibilityFactor(CO2, T=5000, P=1e8)

{ every species in the table, one property each }
h_o2    = Enthalpy(O2, T=1200)
h_co2   = Enthalpy(CO2, T=1200)
h_co    = Enthalpy(CO, T=1200)
h_h2o   = Enthalpy(H2O, T=1200)
h_h2    = Enthalpy(H2, T=1200)
h_ch4   = Enthalpy(CH4, T=1200)
h_c2h6  = Enthalpy(C2H6, T=1200)
h_c3h8  = Enthalpy(C3H8, T=1200)
h_c4h10 = Enthalpy(C4H10, T=1200)
h_c2h4  = Enthalpy(C2H4, T=1200)
h_c2h2  = Enthalpy(C2H2, T=1200)
h_so2   = Enthalpy(SO2, T=1200)
h_no    = Enthalpy(NO, T=1200)
h_no2   = Enthalpy(NO2, T=1200)
h_n2o   = Enthalpy(N2O, T=1200)
h_oh    = Enthalpy(OH, T=1200)
h_hat   = Enthalpy(H, T=1200)
h_oat   = Enthalpy(O, T=1200)
h_nat   = Enthalpy(N, T=1200)
h_c8h18 = Enthalpy(C8H18, T=1200)
h_c12h26 = Enthalpy(C12H26, T=1200)
h_ch3oh = Enthalpy(CH3OH, T=1200)
h_ch4o  = Enthalpy(CH4O, T=1200)
h_c2h5oh = Enthalpy(C2H5OH, T=1200)
h_c2h6o = Enthalpy(C2H6O, T=1200)
